ideas.pitch: A compact 30x30cm differential drive robot running custom PID line-following algorithms with an ultrasonic obstacle-avoidance override to minimize run time.
ideas.title: Speed-Optimized Line & Obstacle Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the primary judging criteria of completion time and obstacles cleared using a robust, highly tuned hardware build reminiscent of award-winning autonomous rovers.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous robot utilizing an ESP32-CAM module running lightweight color or contour detection to navigate complex obstacle courses without manual intervention.
ideas.title: Vision-Guided Maze Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leans into the autonomous category rules, scoring heavily on technical complexity and flawless execution of live runs.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency radio frequency remote control unit equipped with an emergency stop and telemetry feedback to ensure strict compliance with safety rules and time limits.
ideas.title: Wireless Fail-Safe Remote Override System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the reliability and penalty-avoidance metrics in the judging criteria by preventing runaway crashes and tracking maximum run times accurately.

ideas.pitch: A specialized chassis built under strict 30cm dimension limits featuring dual infrared distance sensors for rapid wall-following and high-speed straight-line bursts.
ideas.title: Modular Wall-Hugger Speedster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Optimized purely for the technical inspection and qualifying run speed tests, giving the team a massive advantage in completion time.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent micro-robot that maps obstacles during its first qualifying run and optimizes its path for the final head-to-head showdown.
ideas.title: Dynamic Path-Recalculating Autonomous Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Exceeds standard remote-controlled entries by showcasing advanced autonomy, making it a favorite for top rankings in the final round.
